result.summary: Rebased feature/WF02-REQ-033 onto origin/master (no conflicts, already current) after committing the one uncommitted handoff-status edit. Pushed, opened PR #75 (title references issue #65, body follows the protocol template with DOC-UPDATER's summary as basis, includes 'Closes #65'). Watched CI with `gh pr checks 75 --watch`: both build checks passed (1m39s, 1m46s). Merged with `gh pr merge 75 --squash --delete-branch` -- the GitHub-side merge succeeded (verified via `gh pr view 75 --json state,mergedAt,mergeCommit`: state MERGED, commit 036484d) but the local side-effect checkout errored with a 'not possible to fast-forward' warning because local master carried 8 pre-existing unpushed commits from an earlier WF01-RELEASE-2 run (REQ-033..041 drafting) that this run's feature branch had itself been cut from -- so that content was already included in the squashed PR #75 commit. Diffed local master against origin/master post-merge: the only substantive difference was the REQ-033 status line (origin correctly 'done' from this merge, local stale 'pending' from before it); everything else was old per-step handoff files origin had already squashed away. Confirmed no content would be lost, then `git reset --hard origin/master` to resolve the divergence cleanly rather than rebasing through spurious add/add conflicts on identical content. Deleted the now-fully-merged local feature branch reference via `git fetch --prune` (remote branch was already gone -- `gh api repos/.../branches/feature/WF02-REQ-033` returned 404, confirming `--delete-branch` had in fact succeeded server-side despite the local warning). Verified: branch=master, up to date with origin/master, clean tree, `git log -1` shows 036484d (the squash-merge commit). Closed issue #65 (was already auto-closed by the PR's 'Closes #65' line; added the summary comment the auto-close didn't provide, linking PR #75 and commit 036484d and listing all passed gates). Updated tracker issue #74: read its current body in full via `gh issue view 74 --json body`, flipped only the '- [ ] #65' line to '- [x] #65', left every other line, phase, table row and note untouched, then verified via diff that the round-tripped body matched except for that one line (plus an inconsequential trailing-newline normalization from `gh issue edit`).
artifacts_out: Issue #74: checkbox for #65 flipped to checked

issues.description: Local master had 8 unpushed commits (a WF01-RELEASE-2 requirement-drafting run) sitting ahead of origin/master before this step ran -- this run's feature branch had been cut from that local state, so the content reached origin/master correctly via this PR's squash-merge, but it means some earlier session finished a run without pushing master, leaving local and remote master diverged for another agent to untangle. Worth a standing reminder (or an ORCH-side check) that any step which commits directly to local master should also push it before ending, to avoid the next Step Final needing to reconcile stale local history.
